item.title: Pelosi and Wiener's contentious succession battle escalates
Senate's overnight session ends with SAVE America Act stalled
item.description: The bill was shelved after Senator Mike Lee's expected objection to recess did not materialize during the all-night session.

item.title: Pentagon seeks tenfold missile increase amid Iran conflict and China threat
item.description: The fiscal 2027 budget quadruples interceptor requirements after years of low procurement left defenses strained.
